en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Abdillah b. Sinan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “
One who recites Surah Ahzaab extensively would remain in the neighborhood of Muhammad (s.a.w) and his wives.
Some men and women of Quraish and non-Quraish are disgraced in Surah Ahzaab.
O Ibne Sinaan! It is this Surah that exposed some women of Quraish.”
